summary.title: TestDriven.io – Test-Driven Development Courses and Tutorials
summary.one_liner: A catalog of paid, in-depth courses that teach building and deploying real-world web apps and microservices with test-driven development, Docker, Flask, React, Django, and Angular.
keywords: deploying flask react app to aws
takeaways: The site offers 22 courses, listed as a bundle for $494 (page says it saves $211).
Courses cover TDD with Python, Flask and Docker; authentication with Flask and React; deploying a Flask and React microservice to AWS ECS; and a real-time taxi app with Django Channels and Angular.
Support includes community help via Stack Overflow, email support from the authors, and frequent included course updates.
Free tutorials on related topics such as Kubernetes and Vault are mentioned in testimonials.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for TestDriven.io, a set of paid courses and tutorials on building, testing, and deploying web applications and microservices. The page lists sample courses (TDD with Flask and Docker, Flask and React authentication, deploying to AWS ECS, and a Django Channels and Angular taxi app) and says there are 22 courses in total, with a bundle price of $494. It describes the teaching approach as hands-on, with code samples and step-by-step walkthroughs, and includes user testimonials that are not factual details about the courses themselves.
